platforms.name: KEXP Seattle Digital Rotation Consideration Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Seattle, Washington listener-powered non-commercial radio global digital music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; editorial airplay consideration applies and KEXP explicitly states that artists cannot pay for airplay.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KEXP requires a carefully prepared email to md@kexp.org with streaming and downloadable WAV links, artist and pronoun information, release metadata, phonetic spellings, focus tracks, release dates, clean edits where needed, lyrics, credits, biography or one-sheet and relevant show dates. Attachments and physical submissions are not accepted, so a human must prepare and verify the complete link-based package.
platforms.notes: The official contact page, submission guidelines and current July 11, 2026 programming/events were verified on 2026-07-11. The public business mailbox md@kexp.org is explicitly identified as the preferred submission route. KEXP considers singles, albums and EPs, does not guarantee a response or airplay, rejects physical submissions and says airplay cannot be purchased. No email was sent and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.

platforms.name: WREK 91.1 Atlanta Email and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Atlanta, Georgia Georgia Tech student-radio email and physical music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; any physical media production and shipping costs remain with the sender.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WREK's current music page links to its official legacy submission instructions, which publish music.director@wrek.org and a physical route, state that common formats are accepted and indicate that CDs and LPs may receive more operator attention. A human must choose the delivery method, prepare the release and resolve the current-versus-legacy street-address discrepancy before any physical shipment.
platforms.notes: The current official site actively links the submission instructions and published playlists dated July 9-10, 2026, confirming station activity. The linked official instructions welcome independently produced music, publish music.director@wrek.org, allow email or physical delivery and do not acknowledge every receipt. The current site lists 351 Ferst Drive while the legacy instructions list 350 Ferst Drive, so no physical address has been treated as shipment-ready without manual confirmation. No email was sent, no package was prepared and no deliverability probing was performed.

platforms.name: WTUL 91.5 New Orleans Protected Music-Director Email and Physical Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / New Orleans, Louisiana Tulane University radio protected director-email and physical music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; any physical media and shipping costs remain with the sender.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WTUL directs physical submissions to its published mailing address and digital submissions to the appropriate music director on a staff page where addresses are JavaScript-protected. The same contact page also contains a CAPTCHA-protected general form. A human must select the correct Head, Assistant or International/World Music Director, use the authorized visible interface without automated decoding, and prepare the release package or physical shipment.
platforms.notes: The official contact page and 2025-2026 staff directory were verified on 2026-07-11. WTUL explicitly instructs digital submitters to choose the appropriate music director and lists Head, Assistant and International/World Music Director roles, but the corresponding addresses are protected from spambots and were not decoded. The site provides a live stream and 2026 copyright notice. No form was submitted, no CAPTCHA was handled, no protected contact was decoded and no package was prepared.

platforms.name: WUOG 90.5 Athens Physical Album Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Athens, Georgia University of Georgia student-radio physical album-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical media production and shipping costs remain with the sender.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WUOG explicitly asks artists seeking airtime consideration to mail an album in the appropriate format to its Music Directors. A human must confirm the accepted format, prepare the physical media and release information, address the package correctly and understand that the separately published director emails are contacts rather than an authorization to substitute an email submission.
platforms.notes: The official contact page, current director roster and published station address were verified on 2026-07-11. WUOG publishes its Music Director business mailbox and a separate local-music mailbox, but the authorized submission instruction on the page is physical album delivery. The station states that it focuses on smaller artists and operates a live station site with recent music coverage. No email was sent, no form was submitted and no physical media or package was prepared.

platforms.name: WKDU 91.7 Philadelphia Music Submission Contact Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Drexel University freeform radio topic-specific music-submission form route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; station review applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WKDU provides a public contact form with a dedicated Music Submission topic and required name, email, subject and message fields, but publishes no detailed audio-link, file-format or metadata requirements on that page. A human must inspect the live form, select the correct topic, prepare a concise rights-cleared inquiry or pitch and avoid supplying files or links that the station has not authorized.
platforms.notes: The official contact form and current station activity were verified on 2026-07-11. WKDU published playlists through July 10, 2026 and events dated July 12 and July 15, 2026. No visible CAPTCHA, payment or public-form login requirement was observed; a separate station login exists but is not needed for the public contact route. The form was not submitted and no music, links or files were supplied.
